proposal_name: Commercial Property, Business Interruption & Cyber Risk Liability RFP
extracted_text:
COMMERCIAL PROPERTY, ASSET & CYBER RISK INSURANCE PROPOSAL
RFP Reference No: RFP-COMM-PROP-2026-881
Issuing Authority: Reliance Industrial Manufacturing & Cloud Services Ltd
Target Insurance Archetype: Commercial P&C / General Insurance
Policy Term: October 1, 2026 – September 30, 2027

1. COVERAGE LINES & SUM INSURED:
- Line 1: Standard Fire & Special Perils (SFSP) & Industrial All Risks (IAR): USD 150,000,000 aggregate asset limit
- Line 2: Business Interruption (BI) & Increased Cost of Working: USD 40,000,000 with 12 months indemnity period
- Line 3: Enterprise Cyber Risk & Ransomware Liability: USD 25,000,000 aggregate limit
- Line 4: Commercial General Liability (CGL): USD 15,000,000 any one occurrence / aggregate
- Deductibles: Property damage deductible USD 100,000; Cyber extortion retention USD 50,000
- Catastrophe Exposure: Sub-limit of USD 50,000,000 for earthquake and flood perils

2. COMMERCIAL PRICING:
- Annual Estimated Premium: USD 1,850,000
- Premium Payment Terms: 4 equal quarterly installments, payable within 15 days of quarter start

3. UNDERWRITING & RISK MANAGEMENT:
- Mandatory On-site Survey: Initial risk engineering safety audit within 45 days of policy inception
- Statutory Solvency: Insurer must have an AM Best rating of 'A-' or higher, or CRISIL/ICRA AAA rating
- Minimum Net Retention: Insurer must maintain minimum 20% net retention on property risk

4. CLAIMS & RECOVERY SLA:
- On-site Surveyor Deputation: Licensed independent surveyor appointed within 24 hours of major incident
- Immediate Interim Payout: 50% advance on undisputed property losses exceeding USD 1,000,000 within 21 days

5. DYNAMIC & PROPOSAL-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS:
- Cyber Incident Forensic Team Dispatch: 24x7 incident response team dispatch within 4 hours of breach
- Global Sanctions Compliance Warranties: Insurer must execute OFAC and global sanctions warranty
